candidate_windows.window_text: We use BERT (Devlin et al., 2019) base as initialization and only the first 4 layers are utilized. Our model is implemented by PyTorch (Paszke et al., 2019) and DGL (Wang et al., 2019c). We randomly select 1M sentences provided by Xu (2019) as pretraining corpus and pad the sentences to a max length of 128. We set the learning rate as 5e-5, batch size as 1024, and pre-train 10K steps on 4 RTX 3090 for around 2 days.
